changelog:
- Static & Carousel Ad Detection: Added detection for 'Ad' badges and commercial CTA buttons (Shop Now, Book Now, Apply Now, Install Now) across Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
- Free Back Navigation: Previously skipped ads are recorded in an LRU memory cache, allowing users to scroll back freely through any number of reels/shorts.
- Zero-Interference Re-visits: When navigating back into an ad, users can stay and view the ad indefinitely without forced forward skipping.
